title: Read active deployment and Alex worker failure evidence
instruction:
Darius approved repairing task failures. THIS JOB IS READ-ONLY INFRASTRUCTURE DIAGNOSIS. The code repair is already being tested on fix/codex-failure-reliability-20261019; do not edit code or deploy anything in this job. Runtime also rejects Rory/direct_codex as unknown; do not enable that lane. Use the existing Taylor GCP/Cloud Run read path.

Codex could not complete this run (exit 1) before producing a response. Return only sanitized correlation ID, timestamp, attempt, exit code, normalized cause, duration, provider/model/Codex version, whether model or tool work started, and non-secret auth-readiness status. (3) Existing authorized deployment/rollback path for the tested worker fix. Do not deploy.

Use known configured tools first; stop a check at its exact missing permission instead of broad discovery. GitHub receives the answer: INFRASTRUCTURE METADATA ONLY. Never return raw traces, prompts, stderr, tokens, env values, credential files, Salesforce content, customer identity, billing data or SQL rows. Keep sensitive evidence private.
